en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European hill town. A winding path and fenced gardens lead up a slope covered with many flowering trees. On the hilltop stand dense rows of ornate late‑19th‑century houses and a prominent Gothic‑revival church with a tall spire. To the right, a large fortified complex or castle occupies the edge of a rocky cliff above the town. In the foreground are compact townhouses and a tall factory chimney. The sky is blank and there is no printed caption or writing visible.
